description: Fetch a single Spotify podcast episode (open.spotify.com/episode/{id}) — one installment of a podcast, NOT the podcast itself (use spotify/get-podcast for that). Returns title, parent show (id/url/title), publish date, duration (ms), full episode description, explicit flag, video-episode flag, cover art, and the 30-second mp3 preview URL. --include-related adds the page's 'More like this' episode recommendations. Runs in a browser context (Spotify's GraphQL API is not anonymously callable); browsing public episodes needs no login. Episode URLs/ids come from spotify/search, spotify/get-podcast episode lists, or spotify/list-new-releases.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Episode URL, e.g. https://open.spotify.com/episode/7CJ7dioRxLKDCIsK2K0c7y. Take it from the episodes array of spotify/get-podcast, spotify/search (type=episodes), or spotify/list-new-releases results. Mutually exclusive with --id (one is required).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The 22-character episode id from the /episode/ URL segment, e.g. 7CJ7dioRxLKDCIsK2K0c7y. Mutually exclusive with --url (one is required).

parameters.name: include_related
parameters.description: Set true to also return 'More like this' episode recommendations (id/url/title/show). Default false.
